request.style: English, male baritone solo, gentle choir support, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, contemplative and hopeful, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
How long, LORD, must I call for help
I cry out to you, Violence!
Why do you make me see wrongdoing?
Destruction and violence are before me

[Pre-Chorus]
The law goes numb, justice never comes forth
The wicked hem in the righteous

[Chorus]
But the righteous shall live by his faith
The vision awaits its appointed time
Look at the proud one, his soul is not upright
The righteous shall live by his faith

[Verse]
Look among the nations and watch
Be astonished, be astounded
I am doing a work in your days
You would not believe if it were told

[Chorus]
But the righteous shall live by his faith
The vision awaits its appointed time
Look at the proud one, his soul is not upright
The righteous shall live by his faith

[Bridge]
Though the fig tree does not blossom
And the vines bear no fruit
Yet I will exult in the LORD
I will rejoice in the God of my salvation

[Outro]
The LORD God is my strength
He makes my feet like the feet of a deer
Sets me upon the heights
